sourceSelection: Deploy from a clean checkout of sourceCommit. Verify every manifest binding before copying; do not deploy the mutable working tree.

verification.execution: isolated worktree matched sourceCommit for package.json, lib, scripts, tests and .scratch/org-v2

review.scope: ticket 16 commits and their repairs; independent ticket 37 commit d43006e excluded from the two review axes

deployment.supportScope: tests/** and .scratch/org-v2/** support duty-probe-failure, model eval and cutover smoke; full preflight remains repository-side
deployment.preserveOtherDeploymentPaths: Only the listed files and deploymentOnly entries are changed; root historical documents and external dependencies remain in place.

backup.verification: After copying, read every destination and compare SHA-256 and byteLength. Record source modes. Do not modify deployment until all bindings agree.
backup.rollbackSource: The Git point is the repository state before ticket 16. The deployed version predates it; restore actual deployed bytes only from the verified deployment backup if the user orders rollback.

legacyArchive.verification: Quiesce the old processes, recheck the source inventory, copy exclusively, verify every file, then and only then clear the listed runtime paths.

providerBridge.action: Use the public loadOverlayPatches parser to copy only config.providers.niko into a new llm-pi-ai settings section. Existing scaffolding reads this compatibility source on every bot start; current DSH migrates each bot settings file into its profile. Do not print configuration values or commit them.
providerBridge.reason: Current host moved provider configuration to web/cordis.patch.yml; both legacy global settings.yaml and web settings.yaml are absent.

proposedConfiguration.activation: Enable only the existing commented bots/dsh-bots insertion in the web patch after the host is stopped; preserve all other entries.

authorizationItems.action: Create and verify the deployment/config backup; sync the manifest and remove its 19 obsolete deployment entries; create the selected-provider compatibility source and activate the bots web entry.
Stop the identified old host/bot generations if still alive. After archive and roster replacement, start web on 3100 and let it spawn the two new bots. No other processes are stopped.
Retire lead, bot-mt0x6r0y, reviewer-lead and reviewer-second. Atomically establish exactly the two proposed v2 seats, with the coordinator anchor present in every nonempty registry.

Archive only legacyArchive.inventory under the ignored repository directory, verify every copy, then clear those old runtime paths. Preserve knowledge, instance history, web profile, dependencies and unrelated data.
Run the predeclared single task with real model turns, task-ID-only mail wakeups, a fresh review Agent, delivery, settlement and closure; retain redacted receipts and task ledger projections.

executionOrder: Obtain all five authorizations and confirm both seat assignments; revalidate manifest, registry, config, archive sources, report ID, task ID and ports. Stop on any mismatch.
Create the exclusive backup and verify every byte binding. Quiesce only the authorized old generations before changing active configuration or data.
Copy and verify the old-seat archive. Only after verification, clear the enumerated old paths and establish the exact new roster without a mixed running period.
Sync and verify all deployment files, remove only enumerated obsolete files, create the provider compatibility source, enable the bots entry, then start the authorized host/bot chain.
Run deploy host probes and the cutover CLI. Require exact source digests, both live generation-bound channels, initial grants, all A-group coordinates and PASS without SKIP.
Run the declared real smoke. Save execution receipts and archive/backup bindings with a new self-hashed artifact; update ticket 16 only from those facts.

smoke.revalidation: Before intake, confirm taskId is unused and nextReportId still equals reportId. Stop and generate a new plan if either changed; never change acceptance after intake.

brief.goal: 用真实双席完成一条预登记任务的收单、派单、登记工件、独立复核与结算。
brief.boundaries: 仅经组织命令提交工件与状态，不直接写 ~/.dsh；不改产品、部署、冻结件或旧知识条目。报告简述实际完成的动作并含本批标记。

operations: implementer task.accept + task.start + knowledge.register + evidence.probe + task.report
fresh coordinator review: artifact.read + evidence.probe + review.report
smoke.wakeups: Use the existing user mail endpoint with taskId only to wake ordinary bot turns; do not place capability envelopes or producer reasoning in mail.
passRequires: one task reaches closed through the recorded main-flow states
the artifact is registered by implementer for this task and passes the frozen criterion
the independent review records the configured model identity and closes the required review point
no outstanding exception or review gap
both seats remain ready after closure
smoke.evidence: Capture task-scoped ledger events/projection, redacted command receipts, readiness, artifact ID/hash/byteLength and review session ID/model identity. Exclude CSRF, IPC tokens, capability envelopes and provider secrets.

limits: This plan and its preflight log are repository preparation, not deployment, runtime readiness, smoke evidence, or a new package in the frozen evidence chain.
User decides rollback; no rehearsal or automatic rollback.
UI visual acceptance remains ticket 18's named human check; no machine result substitutes for it.
A manual dsh web host self-registration is a routine user action; attribute it and do not investigate beyond that.
